text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr got injured while training, so I've escorted her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm very sorry for the trouble. I was careless.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That said, this injury is akin to a minor stumble in the face of an adverse wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: We'd better take it easy for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But an injury of this nature is really nothing that warrants concern…
choice_data_list: It's always better to be safe than sorry.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …A good point well made. It is true that bursters blow very abruptly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Injuries are no less deserving of caution than the forces of nature. I'll take proper care of myself and recover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr reluctantly agrees to rest and recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's head back to the track. We can train at the level of a gentle breeze and—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: I think even light training might be risky.
I think even light training might be risky.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …It does seem that way. If I push myself too hard here, I'll end up struggling to manage even a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Although I'd rather not, I'll spend the remainder of the day at rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr reluctantly decides not to train today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It may only be a gentle breeze, but the wind really is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking care not to push herself too hard, Yamanin Zephyr continues her training session.
